attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 original small card is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides mascot identity and anatomy only. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the real source hair, which is bareheaded short black slicked side-parted hair, and the actual dark eyebrow hair. Retain the prominent real thick dark-framed rounded or oval spectacles with fine understated fittings. Keep the serious closed mouth and clean understated upper lip and chin, with no invented moustache, beard, cap, or uniform. Maintain the dark grey or navy open civilian suit, white or pale shirt collar, and red or burgundy subtly patterned necktie exposed beside the note. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. No invented insignia, text, or accessories. Fine primary details that are indistinct must stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED short BLACK slicked/side-parted hair and actual dark eyebrow HAIR, prominent real thick DARK-framed rounded/oval spectacles, serious CLOSED mouth and clean understated upper lip/chin. DARK GREY/NAVY OPEN civilian suit, WHITE/PALE shirt collar and RED/BURGUNDY subtly patterned necktie exposed beside note. Keep exact small-card primary pose/roll/light/crop and actual frame silhouette; no invented moustache, beard, cap or uniform. Fine eyeglass fittings understated.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged primary and matched analysis context, raw master, pair and white/cyan/alpha. Correctly retains black side-parted hair/brows, thick dark rimmed spectacles, clean closed face, open grey/navy suit/pale shirt/red-burgundy patterned tie. Reject because yellow lower face slopes into a sharp V-shaped tip at narrow shirt opening; needs compact rounded short chin and raised broad shirt collar while keeping exact primary pose and all correct features. Internal backing/note/dark cloth opaque without visible cyan holes; repair geometry only.
